title: Neural Network from Scratch
blurb: Write forward and backward passes in NumPy and train a digit classifier.
brief: Build a small multi-layer neural network using only NumPy: dense layers, ReLU/tanh and softmax, cross-entropy loss, backpropagation, mini-batch SGD with momentum. Train it on a digit-recognition dataset (scikit-learn's bundled digits works offline). Prove your backprop is correct with a numerical gradient check and show training and validation curves.
requirements: Dense layers with sensible weight initialization (He or Xavier)
Forward pass with at least one nonlinearity and a softmax output
A backward pass implementing backpropagation by hand
A numerical gradient check that compares analytic and numeric gradients
Mini-batch training loop with SGD (momentum or Adam) and validation accuracy tracking
deliverables: The network implementation as a module
Gradient-check test that fails if backprop is wrong
resume_bullet: Implemented a neural network with manual backpropagation and gradient checking in NumPy, reaching high accuracy on handwritten digits.
